text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one day bug was discovered in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx on 2026-04-23 where selected values appeared one day behind the label.","The bug only affected users with negative UTC offset timezones.","The root cause was clock skew between two hosts in the system.","The fix involved switching the deadline implementation from a regular clock to a monotonic clock.","The fix was submitted in PR #5537 on the branch fix/off-by-one-day-1.","The bug could be reproduced by selecting the first of the month and reopening the date picker.","Resolving this bug eliminated 9 duplicate rows per day from being written to the system."]}
